name: Vrock

source.note: The 2025 Monster Manual's Vrock, read twice from aidedd.org's page for it on 2026-10-18 (both reads agreed on every number). Spores' 1d10 Poison at the start of each of the target's turns isn't tracked (the Poisoned condition and its repeat save are), and Demonic Restoration isn't built (a vrock killed here stays dead). Stunning Screech's rule that demons succeed automatically isn't needed: nothing the party meets here is a demon.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.summary: If it dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor and it revives with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss (not built: here it stays dead).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Shred
actions.summary: Beak and talons together: 2d6+3 Piercing plus 3d6 Poison.

actions.name: Spores
actions.summary: Recharge 6. A cloud of spores: each creature within 20 ft, DC 15 Con save or Poisoned, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns (Holy Water on it ends the effect early; the 1d10 Poison at the start of its turns isn't tracked).

actions.name: Stunning Screech
actions.summary: 1/Day. Each creature within 20 ft: DC 15 Con save or 3d6 Thunder and Stunned until the end of the vrock's next turn.

summary: A vulture-headed demon turned to stone on the Tsolenka gate wall, who wakes when the gate is forced.
